bends.note: angle point (both building lines turn): NNE leg up to Marquis/Farrells at dx/dy ~-0.3, SSE leg down toward Symmes at ~+0.12 (this sheet is drawn with north rotated ~31 deg to the upper left)
curve: after taking in Symmes, Florence turns from the SSE leg onto the leg that runs to the lower-left edge (the west part of Florence toward Reading Road on sheet 176)

ends.note: east end at the C.L.& N. R.R. curve (lots 26-33 at the end)

notes: Sheet drawn with north rotated about 31 deg toward the upper left (compass at left), so north-south streets such as Marquis run from upper left to lower right and east-west streets such as Arden run up to the right. Names printed without a suffix (ARDEN, MARQUIS, BOONE, DES MOINES, SYMMES, MORRIS) recorded as '... Street', matching sheet 176. Arden is printed 'ARDEN (MARION)'. Arden crosses Marquis at the upper left (only the corners of the four blocks are drawn; the area west of Marquis is sheet 176) and runs NE across the C.L.& N. R.R. to Boone, where it ends; Boone continues a short way to Florence (pipes join). Marquis / Des Moines / Florence / Farrells Ct form one junction: Des Moines (30', label at the junction) ends at Marquis' centreline; Marquis meets Florence's centreline at (1536,1774) and Farrells Court (printed 'FARRELLS CT.', 30') continues across Florence to the east, so both names are recorded at that crossing (computed centreline crossings were 34 px apart: Marquis/Florence ~(1531,1790), Farrells/Florence ~(1542,1758)). Florence (60') runs down the left part of the sheet with one angle point, takes in Symmes (Symmes' east side ends at a wedge point at ~(1413,3271); the T is where Symmes' centreline meets Florence's), then curves to the lower-left edge. Eden Park Entrance (printed 'EDEN PARK ENTRANCE', 80') leaves Florence at the curve and runs east to Gilbert Av., where it ends (6 in. pipe and Eden Park beyond, Gilbert's east line unbroken). Deer Creek Road (printed 'DEER CREEK RD', no width printed) leaves the south side of Florence's west leg at the bottom left; only its NE line is drawn here, so its centre is taken 60 ft from that line (the width it has on sheet 160, and the gap between its two lines on sheet 176), which agrees with the position of the same junction on sheet 176. Morris (printed 'MORRIS' along a 4 in. pipe) comes in from the right edge and ends at Gilbert Av. (100'). The C.L.& N. R.R. and the City Buildings yard between it and Gilbert have no streets.
